user.title: Connect to Slopify
user.description: Sign in with your Slopify account. Home Assistant keeps a sign-in token, never your password; it shows up as "Home Assistant" in Slopify's list of signed-in devices, where you can revoke it.

data_description.url: The address you open Slopify at in your browser, with the port if it has one.
data_description.username: Your Slopify username. Each account gets its own player in Home Assistant.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Slopify again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved sign-in for {username} on {url} no longer works (it was signed out, or the password changed). Sign in again to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Change the Slopify server address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the server moved or got a new address. Sign in again as the same account.

data_description.url: The address you open Slopify at.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_url: That is not a web address. Use the address you open Slopify at in your browser.
error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check the address and port, and that Home Assistant can reach the server.
error.not_slopify: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Slopify server.
error.password_change_required: This account has to change its password first. Sign in to the Slopify app, set a new password, then try again here.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Slopify account is already set up.
abort.not_ipv4: Only servers found at an IPv4 address can be set up from discovery. Add Slopify by hand instead.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Slopify account. Sign in as the account this entry was set up with, or add the other account separately.

data_description.default_source: Used by Play and play media when nothing is playing anywhere. "Where it last played" picks the speaker the music was last on.

auth_failed.message: Slopify did not accept the saved sign-in.

not_connected.message: Not connected to Slopify right now. Home Assistant keeps trying to reconnect.

nothing_playing.message: Nothing is playing on Slopify right now.

nothing_to_resume.message: There is nothing to resume yet. Play something first.

no_source.message: Nothing is playing, so Slopify does not know where to play. Pick a source, pass one as extra: source, or set "Where to start playing" in the Slopify integration options.

unknown_source.message: There is no source called "{source}". Available: {sources}.

unsupported_media.message: Slopify only plays music from its own library; it cannot play "{media_id}".

media_not_found.message: Nothing in the Slopify library matches "{media_id}".
